transcript.content: Hi, I'm having trouble with my Outlook — it's not sending emails.
Let me transfer you to a specialist who handles email issues.
Hi, I was transferred. I'm having an Outlook issue.
Okay, can you tell me what's happening?
Let me transfer you to our senior team for this.
This is the third person I've spoken to. I just need my email fixed.
I understand, let me start from the beginning. What's your name?
Outlook won't send emails. I've already been through this twice.

ticket.summary: Outlook not sending - transferred multiple times
ticket.description: Ticket was reassigned twice. Each handoff required repeating discovery. Issue still unresolved. User frustrated.

expected.notes: Catastrophic handoff. Each agent punted without context. No discovery done. Ticket captures nothing useful. Multi-assignee handoff failure mode. Inspired by assignee-change patterns in Mendeley data.
